name: @dsr/archive
description: Web archive of recorded sessions, browsable by session and by streamer.

scripts.dev: tailwindcss -i src/views/app.css -o dist/app.css --watch=always & esbuild src/client/player.ts src/client/crop.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --watch=forever & cd ../.. && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/archive/tsconfig.json node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --import tsx apps/archive/src/main.ts
